subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In a 2023 study, cognitive scientist Dr. Emily Thornton and colleagues tested the use of virtual reality (VR) therapy for treating anxiety disorders.
• VR therapy involves using immersive digital environments to expose patients to anxiety-triggering situations in a controlled setting.
• Finding: VR therapy reduced patient anxiety scores by 38% more than traditional therapy.
• Finding: The treatment achieved 72% patient completion rates.
• The authors concluded that VR therapy showed "significant promise as an accessible and effective intervention for anxiety treatment."
prompt: The student wants to present the findings of the study. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The authors concluded that VR therapy was "accessible and effective," having achieved 72% patient completion rates in a 2023 study.
choices.B: In a 2023 study, Thornton and colleagues found that VR therapy achieved 38% higher patient completion rates than traditional therapy.
choices.C: Thornton and colleagues found that VR therapy not only reduced patient anxiety scores but also achieved high patient completion rates.
choices.D: VR therapy, Thornton and colleagues found, achieved 72% completion rates and reduced 38% of patient anxiety scores.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The sentence presents both findings from the study, noting that VR therapy both reduced patient anxiety scores and achieved high patient completion rates.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence misrepresents information in the notes. VR therapy reduced anxiety scores by 38% more than traditional therapy, not 38% of the total anxiety scores. Additionally, the completion rate figure lacks context; it was 72% overall completion rate.
